  • Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities?


If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team! Please review the minimum education/experience requirements below to see if you qualify for the position.


About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies.


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:


Compensation:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $4,200 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Assistant for a minimum of 1 year with competent performance and become eligible for promotion to the Specialist position.


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting total monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $9,000 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:


·      High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.


Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.


Minimum/Required and Preferred Qualifications


Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:

·      Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

·      A minimum of 1 year of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 1-year requirement).

·      A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

·      A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.

·      Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.

·      3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred. 

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred.


Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:

·      Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

·      At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English is required . Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English.

·      A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is required.

·      Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.

·      A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred.

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred .

You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6-months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

Somos uma consultoria especializada em TI , apaixonada por desafios e comprometida em impulsionar transformações tecnológicas estratégicas para nossos clientes. Se você busca crescimento profissional e deseja atuar em projetos inovadores, essa oportunidade é para você.


Modelo de contratação: PJ

Modalidade: Home Office


Requisitos

• Experiência prática em Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts).

• Conhecimento em CI/CD, Git, YAML pipelines e automação de builds/deploys.

• Vivência em gestão de acesso e políticas de segurança no Azure.

• Familiaridade com PowerShell, Terraform, ARM Templates ou Bicep para infraestrutura

como código.

• Capacidade de auditar e organizar ambientes legados, propondo melhorias de

governança.

• Boa comunicação e autonomia para interagir com áreas de desenvolvimento, segurança e

infraestrutura.

• Excelente comunicação e capacidade de traduzir linguagem técnica em

impacto de negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Principais Atividades e Desafios:

• Estruturar e implantar a governança completa do Azure DevOps, incluindo políticas,

permissões, pipelines e controles de acesso.

• Implementar proteção do código-fonte (branch policies, code reviews obrigatórios, gestão

de secrets e credenciais).

• Revisar e organizar repositórios existentes, garantindo versionamento adequado e

padronização de nomenclaturas.

• Automatizar pipelines de CI/CD para garantir entregas consistentes e seguras.

• Integrar processos de DevOps com Azure, GitHub, Power BI, SonarQube ou ferramentas

de monitoramento.

• Apoiar squads e desenvolvedores na adoção de boas práticas de versionamento, build e

release.

• Monitorar e manter segurança, compliance e performance do ambiente de DevOps.


Diferenciais:

• Certificação Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert.

• Experiência em integração DevSecOps.

• Conhecimento em políticas de proteção de código e auditoria em ambientes regulados.

• Vivência em automação de governança (Policy as Code, GitHub Advanced Security, etc.).


Se identificou com a oportunidade? Envie seu CV e venha fazer parte do nosso time.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - Node + React
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - Node + React


*Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


*Nosso cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente que atua no segmento de fabricação e comercialização de eletrodomésticos e eletroportáteis.


*O que buscamos?

Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior com sólida experiência em Node.js, React, SQL, Crons, Docker, Argo CD, Sequelize e TypeORM. O profissional será responsável por um novo projeto.


*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Node.js, utilizando Sequelize e TypeORM para interação com bancos de dados relacionais.

• Criar e otimizar APIs RESTful e serviços para comunicação entre sistemas.

• Implementar e manter aplicações frontend utilizando React.js e TailwindCSS.

• Criar e gerenciar tarefas agendadas (crons) para automação de processos críticos.

• Implementar e gerenciar containers com Docker e orquestração com Argo CD.

• Desenvolver consultas otimizadas em SQL Server, PostgreSQL ou MySQL.

• Atuar na integração e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD para garantir entregas contínuas e seguras.

• Diagnosticar e corrigir problemas de performance e segurança no backend e frontend.

• Trabalhar com metodologias ágeis, garantindo boas práticas de Clean Code e Design Patterns.


*O que você precisa ter

• Experiência avançada com Node.js (Express, NestJS).

• Experiência com React.js e boas práticas de frontend.

• Conhecimento sólido em bancos SQL e ORM (Sequelize e TypeORM).

• Experiência com criação e gerenciamento de Jobs/crons para automação.

• Conhecimento avançado em Docker para criação e gerenciamento de containers.

• Experiência com orquestração de deploys usando Argo CD.

• Prática com CI/CD e deploys automatizados.

• Boa experiência com integração de APIs e segurança (JWT, OAuth, OpenID).

• Sólidos conhecimentos em estruturas de dados, algoritmos e padrões de arquitetura.


*Diferenciais:

• Experiência com NestJS e arquitetura Clean Code.

• Conhecimento em Kubernetes e infraestrutura como código.

• Experiência com mensageria (Redis).

• Conhecimento em React Native.


Observações:

• Oportunidade para 6 meses iniciais e grande possibilidade de prorrogação.


*Onde você vai trabalhar?

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Híbrido em Curitiba – PR, no Bacacheri. São 3 dias presenciais e 2 remotos. O dia que todos vão presencial é na quarta e os outros 2 dias de presencial o profissional pode escolher. Importante ressaltar que o primeiro mês é 100% presencial para imersão no ambiente, treinamentos e alinhamentos. O híbrido se aplica a partir do mês subsequente.

title: Account Assistant – Social Creators (Júnior)
description:
A WIP é um estúdio de design de narrativa que une storytelling e branding de forma estratégica, fazendo gestão de criadores e conteúdos para gerar impacto cultural através das marcas. Trabalhamos com métodos proprietários e processos ágeis para desenvolver narrativas e projetos que conectam, engajam e geram valor real.


Sobre o cargo


Como Account Assistant – Social Creators (Júnior), você será responsável por dar suporte ao time na operação do dia a dia com criadores de conteúdo.

O foco da vaga é organização, acompanhamento das entregas e apoio na comunicação com criadores e clientes.


É uma vaga para quem está começando no mercado, gosta do universo de conteúdo e quer aprender rápido sobre influência, redes sociais e rotinas de campanhas.


Responsabilidades principais


  • Dar apoio nas primeiras conversas com criadores (envio de informações, coleta de valores e detalhes básicos);
  • Acompanhar criadores após a contratação (repassar briefings, tirar dúvidas simples, organizar prazos e entregas);
  • Garantir atualização das informações em planilhas e sistemas internos;
  • Ajudar no controle de entregas (roteiros, vídeos, posts, stories, prazos e refações);
  • Fazer checklists, atualizar status e apoiar no envio de materiais para aprovadores;
  • Auxiliar na organização de reuniões, pautas e acompanhamentos;
  • Pesquisar tendências de redes sociais e referências simples para apoiar os projetos;
  • Ajudar no mapeamento inicial de criadores, buscando perfis alinhados ao briefing.


Qualidades esperadas


  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para lidar com pessoas;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes (vai lidar com prazos e muitas informações);
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer no universo de criadores;
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e com boa gestão de prioridades;
  • Fluência em espanhol (obrigatório).


Ferramentas utilizadas

﻿

  • Influency.me
  • Social Blade
  • TikTok, Instagram, YouTube e Twitch
  • Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)
  • Canva
  • Monday
  • Slack

description:

Somos uma clínica odontológica premium , referência em odontologia digital, estética e reabilitação oral .

Nosso propósito é transformar vidas, cuidando de pessoas, realizando sonhos e sorrisos.

Acreditamos que excelência, ética, energia, satisfação do cliente e senso de dono são mais do que valores — são a base da nossa cultura e do nosso crescimento.

  • Perfil persuasivo, empático e focado em metas ;
  • Domínio de CRM e gestão de leads ;

Nosso lema


Na OdontoBarra, a venda é consequência do encantamento.

Buscamos profissionais que unem propósito, técnica e resultado.

  • Vivência com Windows Server, incluindo IIS, MSMQ, serviços e rotinas;
  • Conhecimento em outros frameworks frontend (Angular, Vue);
  • Experiência com microsserviços, modernização e migração de monolitos;
  • Domínio de Docker, Kubernetes e soluções serverless (cloud ou on-premises);

Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar e manter APIs REST e GraphQL, garantindo performance, segurança e qualidade;
  • Colaborar com equipes de DevOps para otimizar pipelines, ambientes e infraestrutura;
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, promovendo boas práticas de codificação, testes e arquitetura;

title: Banco de Talentos | Profissionais de Ciência de Dados (PJ) – Brasil
description:

Este anúncio não corresponde a uma vaga específica , mas sim à formação de um grupo de profissionais que poderão ser acionados conforme novas oportunidades forem abertas. Este anúncio não se trata de oferta de curso, programa educacional ou venda de serviços.


Requisito obrigatório

– Possuir empresa aberta (CNPJ) para prestação de serviços no modelo PJ.


Principais áreas de atuação

– Apoio em projetos de ciência de dados e inteligência artificial

– Análise de dados, modelagem estatística e desenvolvimento de soluções orientadas por dados

– Construção, acompanhamento e evolução de modelos preditivos, prescritivos e demais modelos analíticos

– Suporte técnico em iniciativas e projetos de dados conforme necessidades dos clientes

– Participação na definição, implementação e melhoria de processos analíticos


Competências valorizadas

– Raciocínio analítico e visão sistêmica

– Conhecimentos em programação

– Experiência prévia em ciência de dados

– Comunicação clara e postura consultiva

– Capacidade de adaptação e autonomia


Como funciona o Banco de Talentos

Os profissionais serão avaliados e mantidos em um banco ativo. Quando surgirem projetos compatíveis, a equipe da Envalyss realizará o contato para avançar no processo.


Como se candidatar

A candidatura deve ser realizada diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Durante o processo, você poderá indicar se autoriza sua participação no Banco de Talentos para oportunidades futuras.


Atualização e exclusão de dados (LGPD)

Os dados serão utilizados exclusivamente para análise de perfil e contato em processos futuros. Para atualizar ou excluir suas informações, envie e-mail para:

title: Líder de Projetos - SAP (ABAP/BW)
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Líder de Projetos — Equipes SAP ABAP e BW


Remoto - Brasil.

Horário - Comercial.


Procuramos profissional experiente para conduzir e desenvolver equipes SAP ABAP e BW. Profissional focado em liderança técnica, governança de entregas e capacitação de times, que será o ponto focal de sustentação e projetos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear competências técnicas e gaps da equipe, identificando planos de desenvolvimento individuais;
  • Promover e estruturar a fábrica de ABAP, definindo processos, padrões e boas práticas;
  • Definir, implantar e acompanhar o programa de capacitação e certificação das equipes;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de profissionais em início de carreira e de novos consultores, garantindo ramp-up eficiente;
  • Organizar a cobertura de férias, assegurando continuidade das entregas;
  • Acompanhar e garantir o apontamento correto de horas e conformidade com políticas internas;
  • Apoiar processos de contratação e desligamento de consultores, em alinhamento com RH;
  • Atuar como ponto focal para suporte técnico às equipes de sustentação e para demandas de projetos;
  • Colaborar com a gerência e stakeholders para priorização de demandas e mitigação de riscos técnicos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes técnicas SAP ABAP e BW;

title: Graphic Designer (Motion)
description:
We’re looking for a Graphic Designer with strong design fundamentals, an eye for storytelling, and the ability to bring visuals to life through motion. You’ll work across social content, digital graphics, brand design, presentations, and motion graphics.

This role is perfect for someone who loves blending design, animation, and smart use of modern tools and AI to create scroll-stopping, brand-aligned content. If you’re detail-oriented, enjoy working across formats, collaborate well with a creative team, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.


What you'll do

  • Design high-quality social media creative, digital graphics, presentations, and branded visual systems across multiple formats and platforms.
  • Create motion graphics and animated elements — including transitions, text animations, graphics packages, and lightweight video edits for short-form content.
  • Apply brand guidelines consistently while finding space for creativity and innovation.
  • Use AI and modern creative tools to speed up ideation, design variations, motion workflows, and content exploration.
  • Collaborate with creative leads and project managers to clarify briefs, address feedback and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Maintain clean, organised files and a high standard of craft across motion and static work.


What you'll bring

  • 2+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer, Motion Designer, or hybrid creative role.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing brand design, social content, motion graphics, and layout expertise.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and strong working knowledge of Figma and presentation design tools.
  • Understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, colour systems, and brand identity.
  • Ability to animate and design for modern platforms (Reels, TikTok, YouTube, paid social, etc).
  • Familiarity with AI or automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Runway and Midjourney).
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with tight timelines and evolving briefs.
  • A collaborative mindset, strong attention to detail, and an ability to embrace and act on feedback.
  • Clear and confident communication in English, with the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate effectively with both creatives and project managers.


Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency, and creativity. Our workflow is built for momentum — pairing great talent with streamlined processes, smart tech and a global, supportive team.


At SoCreative, you’ll have the chance to:

  • Work with ambitious brands across video, design, and motion formats.
  • Collaborate with world-class creatives around the globe.
  • Grow quickly in a company shaping how modern creative production works.
  • Take ownership of your work and contribute meaningfully to projects that move fast and have real impact.

title: Creative Production Lead
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

﻿

About Olly Olly

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we're blending technology and real-world expertise to empower small businesses across the U.S. like never before.


We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That's why we're on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and grow sustainably without the hassle.


The Olly Olly platform complements our hands-on service perfectly: it's no-nonsense, easy-to-use software that helps local businesses streamline operations, drive leads, and maximize revenue with minimal effort so they can focus on what they do best.


Why We Need You

You have the eye. You can look at a website for five seconds and know whether it builds trust or destroys it. You see the logo that looks like a 2008 Fiverr special, the stock photo that screams "we didn't try," the typography that signals cheap. And it bothers you. Physically.


We're building a production team that creates websites, logos, and visual assets for 4,000+ local service businesses—contractors, plumbers, attorneys, HVAC companies. These businesses live or die by how professional they look online. Your job is to make sure everything we ship makes them look like the best option in their market.


As Creative Production Lead , you'll manage a team of designers who assemble websites from content, photos, and structured data. You're not just assigning tickets. You're inspecting work daily, catching the details that kill credibility, coaching your team to see what you see, and refusing to let "good enough" out the door.


You can also DO the work yourself. When a logo needs to be created or fixed, you're not waiting for someone else. When a layout isn't working, you can open the file and make it better. You lead by example because you're a designer first, manager second.


The Impact You'll Have

  • Quality is your obsession. You review completed work daily—not for completion, but for excellence. You catch the weak logo, the amateur photo crop, the layout that buries the CTA, the color palette that feels dated. Nothing ships unless it meets your standards.
  • You inspect, you coach, you elevate. You're providing specific feedback on real work: "This logo doesn't work because the type is fighting the icon." "This hero image undermines trust—the lighting looks fake." "This layout guides the eye away from what matters." You're building your team's taste through detailed critiques.
  • You stay fluid. What looked great two years ago looks tired today. You're constantly studying what's working across industries, updating standards, killing approaches that stopped converting. When you spot a pattern that works, you train the team on it immediately.
  • You execute when needed. Logo needs a refresh? You can do it. Layout falling apart? You fix it. You're not above the work—you're the best at it.
  • You run production, not a gallery. This is high-volume. Your team handles hundreds of sites and thousands of updates monthly. You understand that speed and quality aren't opposites—they require discipline, systems, and people who give a damn.


What We Really Need From You

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years in visual design with a portfolio that demonstrates genuine taste—not just competence, but an eye for what converts vs. what just exists
  • 2+ years leading or managing a design team—you've held people to standards, given hard feedback, and developed talent
  • Hands-on execution skills: you can create and refine logos, fix layouts, improve visual hierarchy yourself
  • Production experience: you've worked in environments where volume mattered—agencies, e-commerce, high-output teams
  • Quality obsession: you reject work that's "fine" because fine doesn't win


What Would Be Big Pluses

  • Background in advertising, branding agencies, or e-commerce design
  • Experience with WordPress page builders (Elementor, WP Bakery, Divi, Gutenberg)—or willingness to learn fast
  • Understanding of conversion principles: what builds trust, what drives action
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems
  • Knowledge of SEO basics and how design choices impact performance


We'll teach you:

  • Our specific tools and workflows
  • WordPress/Elementor if you don't know them (you'll pick it up in a week)
  • Our brand guidelines and quality standards
  • The local service business landscape


What You'll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Salary: Competitive (based on experience and location)
  • Flexible work: 100% remote, core hours 8 AM – 5 PM EST for collaboration
  • Work-life balance: 15 vacation days + U.S. holidays
  • Growth path: This role leads to Director of Creative Production or VP of Creative. You'll build the team, the systems, and the culture.
  • Real impact: Your standards directly determine whether 17,000+ small businesses look like winners or also-rans.


Why Choose Us?

We're evolving from template-driven agency work to genuinely differentiated design. You'll build a team culture where craft matters, where mediocrity gets rejected, and where the work actually helps small businesses compete.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here—and your unique perspective helps us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Junior founding engineer
description:
The mission

Every year, over a million people move to the US on work visas. They're smart, ambitious, and excited—and then they land and realize the US is no longer made for newcomers.

It's overwhelming. The information is scattered across government websites, Reddit threads, and outdated blog posts. Every situation is slightly different, and one wrong step can cost weeks.

SettleKit fixes this. We're building an app that guides immigrants through US settlement step-by-step and use AI to automate it.


We're early-stage and have multi-year runway. We need a salaried Founding Engineer to help us build this.


The role

You'll be our primary full-time engineer, working directly with me (Max, co-founder). We're a small team—you'll have real ownership from day one:


  • Building features end-to-end. Our app is React on the frontend, Node.js/Express on the backend, PostgreSQL via (currently) Supabase.
  • Working on our AI research pipeline. We use LLMs to generate workflow content from source documents
  • Thinking, not just executing


What's next for SettleKit and You

Right now, the app is in closed beta. Here's where we're heading:

  • AI-powered actions. We want to go beyond telling users what to do. Think: AI that helps fill out government forms, generates document checklists, or drafts emails to employers...
  • Mobile app. Vs. today's webapp
  • Broader coverage


What we're looking for

1. Must have:

  • Experience with graph-based, tree, or conditional logic systems—our core product is a decision graph that adapts to each user's situation
  • 2+ years building with React and Node.js (or similar full-stack experience)
  • Comfortable with TypeScript and SQL
  • You've shipped real products
  • Strong communication in English—we work async-first
  • Based in Latin America (Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, or similar)—we're focused on LATAM for timezone overlap with NYC and the strong engineering talent in the region

2. Nice to have:

  • Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude)
  • Mobile development experience (React Native or native iOS/Android)
  • You've seen immigration complexity firsthand, or know people who have

3. What matters more than credentials:

  • You figure things out
  • You write clean code
  • You're excited about the mission


Why this role

  • Founding team. You'll work directly with the founder. Your code ships to real users immediately
  • Build something that matters. Immigration is broken. Help doctors, scientists, engineers, ... settle fast in the US so they can focus on their life and work
  • Learn by building production AI systems. You'll get hands-on experience building real LLM-powered products
  • (Almost) no AI slop. The product has so far been developed by human engineers, supported by Cursor/Claude
  • Compensation: Full-time salaried position, above market rate depending on experience.

title: Ecommerce Specialist (Remote)
description:

You are a highly organized and execution-focused ecommerce professional who can work in a fast-paced environment and follow established processes with accuracy. You have hands-on experience building and updating product listings, managing catalog data, and supporting marketplace operations. You take ownership of your work, demonstrate strong attention to detail, and are comfortable coordinating with cross-functional teams across time zones.

You enjoy problem-solving, working with spreadsheets, improving product detail pages, monitoring catalog health, and supporting advertising and inventory workflows. You are dependable, proactive, and looking for a long-term opportunity to grow within an established and rapidly expanding ecommerce team.

In this role, you will be responsible for creating and updating product listings, managing catalog accuracy, preparing inventory and replenishment reports, coordinating content updates and photoshoots, and supporting day-to-day marketplace operations.

You will collaborate closely with our U.S. Ecommerce Manager, Photography, Product Development, Marketing, and Graphic Design teams to ensure that listings are built correctly, content follows brand guidelines, and catalog data remains clean and consistent. You will monitor listing quality, help troubleshoot issues in Seller Central and Shopify, support FBA replenishment workflows, and assist in maintaining advertising campaigns using established processes and templates.

This role is ideal for someone who is organized, process-driven, detail-oriented, and eager to contribute to a fast-growing ecommerce department.

  • Update product detail pages, A+ content, and brand stores using creative assets provided by internal teams
  • Assist with pay-per-click advertising workflows including keyword updates, bulk uploads, and campaign maintenance
  • Prepare weekly reports on sales, inventory, pricing, and catalog health
  • Open, track, and follow up on support cases within Amazon Seller Central
  • Coordinate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of ecommerce operations
  • Daily check-ins with Ecommerce Manager for prioritization and progress updates

Skills and Experience

  • 1-3+ years of experience working with Amazon Seller Central and Shopify Admin
  • Strong proficiency in Excel (VLOOKUP, filters, formatting, data organization)
  • Familiarity with FBA processes, inventory management, and catalog troubleshooting
  • Experience with PPC workflows (bulk uploads, keyword harvesting, campaign edits)
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to follow SOPs, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines
  • Strong written English and communication skills
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and able to work independently with remote teams
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities

title: Pricing Specialist
description:
About Us

We are a growing freight brokerage and transportation company specializing in time-sensitive, temperature-controlled, and high-touch shipments across the U.S. We work with shippers in industries such as medical, artwork, hazmat, and white-glove services, and we pride ourselves on being responsive, reliable, and solutions-oriented.

We’re looking for a Pricing Specialist to own our day-to-day quoting and pricing strategy, helping us win profitable freight while maintaining strong carrier relationships.


Key Responsibilities

Spot & Contract Pricing

  • Prepare spot quotes for truckload, LTL, reefer, flatbed, and specialty shipments in a fast-paced environment.
  • Analyze customer RFQs/RFPs and build competitive, profitable pricing proposals.
  • Maintain and update pricing matrices, lane guides, and rate tables.

Market & Lane Analysis

  • Monitor daily market conditions (capacity, seasonality, fuel, regional trends) and adjust pricing accordingly.
  • Analyze historical data by lane, customer, and mode to set target margins and identify opportunities.
  • Recommend pricing strategies for new lanes, customers, and verticals.

Collaboration with Sales & Operations

  • Partner with the sales team to support new business opportunities and respond quickly to customer quote requests.
  • Work closely with carrier procurement/operations to understand true cost on lanes, including repositioning, deadhead, and accessorial.
  • Provide clear pricing logic and talking points so the sales team can confidently present rates to customers.

Margin & Performance Management

  • Track win rates, margins, and quote response times, and suggest improvements based on data.
  • Flag unprofitable lanes and customers and propose revised pricing or alternative solutions.
  • Build and maintain dashboards or reports for leadership (e.g., by lane, mode, customer).
  • Tools & Process Improvement
  • Use TMS, load boards, and market data tools to benchmark rates and build accurate quotes.
  • Help refine internal pricing workflows, templates, and SLAs to speed up response times and improve accuracy.


Requirements

Experience

  • 2–5+ years of pricing, carrier procurement, or operations experience in a freight brokerage or 3PL environment.
  • Strong understanding of truckload and/or LTL pricing, including fuel, accessorial, detention, and layover.

Skills

  • Strong English communication skills (writing and speaking) are required. Day-to-day work and communication with our team and customers is in English.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (lookups, pivot tables, basic modeling).
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into clear pricing recommendations.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • High sense of urgency and ability to handle a high volume of quote requests with tight deadlines.

Other

  • Must be based in Colombia, Brazil, Argentina, or Mexico (or nearby LATAM country with similar time zone).
  • Comfortable working remotely and independently, with accountability for results.
  • Able to on Eastern Time hours.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with major TMS platforms and load boards (e.g., DAT, Truckstop, etc.).
  • Prior exposure to temperature-controlled, white glove, hazmat, or airport/air freight-related freight.
  • Experience responding to large RFPs or managing contract bids for enterprise customers.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary in USD plus performance-based bonus.
  • Fully remote role
  • Opportunity to help shape the pricing strategy of a growing brokerage.

Regulatory Officer - Agrochemical Sector (International Scope)
 Location: Netherlands (Relocation Support & Visa Sponsorship Provided)

Are you an experienced regulatory professional with a passion for plant science, compliance, and international markets? A global player in the agrochemical and crop protection sector , headquartered in the Netherlands , is seeking an experienced Regulatory Officer to join their team.

This is a permanent, full-time position based in the Netherlands , and the employer offers full visa sponsorship and relocation support for the right candidate.

About the Role

In this pivotal position, you will be responsible for managing the full life-cycle of regulatory affairs, including product registration, dossier submission, and coordination of field and lab trials for a wide portfolio of products such as pesticides, fungicides, herbicides, biopesticides, plant nutrients, and veterinary products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all activities related to product registration and regulatory compliance across multiple regions (particularly Latin America, Africa, India, and China).

  • Prepare, edit, and submit registration dossiers to agricultural and health authorities.

  • Represent the company in regulatory committees, as well as in discussions with suppliers and customers.

Your Profile

  • Master's degree or higher in Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Biology, or a related scientific discipline.

  • Minimum of 8 years' experience in regulatory affairs for pesticides, particularly in Latin America and Africa .

  • At least 3 years' experience working with GLP and non-GLP laboratories

  • Strong analytical skills and a methodical, accurate working style.

  • Excellent project management and communication skills.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); knowledge of Spanish, Indian or Chinese is a plus.

  • Proficient with MS Office tools.

What's on Offer

  • A dynamic, international role within a growing agrochemical company based in the Netherlands.

title: Podcast Producer
description:
Podcast Producer (Full-Service Management) – Sofia Health


Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Role


Sofia Health is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Podcast Producer to manage the full production workflow of our weekly interview podcast, Sofia Unfiltered. This role handles guest communication, scheduling, episode preparation, editorial coordination, and project management from pre-production through publishing.


We interview physicians, psychologists, authors, wellness experts, and thought leaders. You must be able to communicate professionally, manage multiple moving pieces, and maintain a calm, supportive tone consistent with our brand.


⭐What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) Guest Communication & Outreach
  • Manage all communication with guests from initial outreach to post-episode follow-up
  • Schedule interviews, send confirmations/reminders, and provide prep materials
  • Collect bios, headshots, books, links, and required release forms
  • Draft guest outreach emails and pitch new guests aligned with upcoming content themes
  • Maintain guest pipeline, schedules, and assets in Notion/Google Drive


Episode Planning & Production
  • Prepare episode briefs and host prep sheets
  • Attend live recordings (optional but preferred) to track timestamps and notes
  • Review raw audio/video and provide clear, detailed edit notes to the editor
  • Restructure episodes when needed for clarity, flow, and narrative arc
  • Collaborate on episode titles, angles, hooks, and story direction
  • Choose main promotional clips and quotes for social content


Editing Coordination
  • Send the editor cut notes that are clear, accurate, and time-stamped
  • Review first edit, request revisions, and ensure quality before publishing
  • Ensure the final episode reflects brand voice, pacing, clarity, and guest experience


Publishing & Show Management
  • Write compelling show notes, descriptions, summaries, and timestamps
  • Prepare publishing assets (titles, tags, categories, episode artwork if needed)
  • Upload weekly episodes to our hosting platform (Spotify for Podcasters or similar)
  • Track episode performance metrics and maintain publishing calendar


Marketing & Promotion Support
  • Coordinate with the social media team to deliver clips, quotes, and captions
  • Identify promotional opportunities through guests’ audiences
  • Support the creation of audiograms, reels, and short-form content briefs


Monetization & Growth
  • Assist in creating sponsorship decks and packages
  • Research relevant brand partners to pitch
  • Coordinate guest cross-promotion to increase downloads
  • Identify podcast swaps and collaboration opportunities
  • Track growth trends and propose strategies to expand reach


Host & Media Outreach (Podcast Guest Booking)


  • Research aligned podcasts across wellness, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, mental health, women’s health, lifestyle medicine, and business growth
  • Create a list of high-quality podcasts suitable for Riley as a guest
  • Draft personalized podcast pitches in Riley’s voice
  • Send and manage outreach emails to podcast hosts and producers
  • Track outreach, follow-ups, and confirmed appearances in Notion or a CRM
  • Coordinate scheduling, prep materials, and talking points
  • Prepare Riley with a one-sheet, interview brief, and relevant episodes of the host
  • Identify opportunities for backlinks, newsletter swaps, and co-marketing
  • Track results and optimize pitches based on acceptance rates



You’re a Great Fit If You…


  • Have real podcast producing experience (required—not entry-level)
  • Have excellent written English and can write in a warm, professional tone
  • Are organized and reliable with strong project management skills
  • Love structure, systems, checklists, and keeping details tight
  • Can communicate confidently with high-profile guests
  • Can listen to an episode and identify what needs to be cut for clarity and flow
  • Are comfortable giving editors detailed, accurate instructions
  • Enjoy managing timelines, assets, and follow-ups
  • Can work independently and solve problems proactively
  • Are calm under pressure and able to meet weekly deadlines


⭐ Required Skills & Experience
  • 2+ years experience as a Podcast Producer , Podcast Manager , or similar
  • Experience working with audio/video editors
  • Strong writing and communication skills
  • Ability to review episodes and give editorial direction
  • Experience managing guests and scheduling interviews
  • Familiarity with publishing platforms (Spotify for Podcasters, Buzzsprout, etc.)
  • Strong organizational skills with tools like Notion, Trello, Asana, or Airtable
  • Comfortable coordinating social media assets
  • Ability to work in US time zones when needed


Bonus:

  • Experience with sponsorship outreach or monetization
  • Background in wellness, psychology, health, or coaching content
  • Experience producing long-form interview-style shows
  • Ability to identify clips for short-form video

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.

Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Financial Controller – Brazil

Location: Rio de Janeiro

Employment Type: Permanent | Full-time

Role Overview

A global financial services organisation is seeking a qualified Financial Controller to take full ownership of statutory, management, and operational finance for its Brazil entity. This is a standalone senior finance role with end-to-end accountability for financial control, regulatory compliance, reporting accuracy, systems optimisation, and cross-border financial governance.

The position operates as the primary financial authority for Brazil, acting as the key interface with global finance leadership, external auditors, tax authorities, and regional stakeholders. The role requires deep technical accounting expertise within a regulated, multi-currency, international environment, alongside hands-on ownership of financial systems, controls, and transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full ownership of end-to-end finance operations for the Brazil entity, covering general ledger, AP, AR, fixed assets, cash and balance sheet integrity.
  • Production of accurate and timely monthly management accounts, including detailed variance analysis, KPI reporting and financial performance commentary.
  • End-to-end responsibility for statutory reporting, including preparation and submission of annual financial statements and all federal and state tax filings.
  • Ownership of the month-end and year-end close process, including journals, reconciliations, balance sheet substantiation and audit readiness.
  • Development, implementation and ongoing monitoring of internal controls to ensure compliance with group policies, local regulation and audit standards.
  • Lead the full external audit process, acting as primary point of contact for auditors and resolving technical accounting and control issues.
  • Oversight of transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance in partnership with central tax teams.
  • Drive finance process improvement, automation and system optimisation across record-to-report, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash cycles.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce close timelines, improve working capital efficiency and enhance cash flow forecasting accuracy.
  • Act as finance lead for strategic projects including business growth, restructuring, system upgrades, new entity launches and M&A activity.

Key Requirements (Technical Only)

  • Fully qualified accountant: CRC, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent.
  • Proven experience in financial control, controllership or senior finance leadership within a regulated, multi-entity environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP and international accounting standards (IFRS / local GAAP).
  • Demonstrated experience leading statutory reporting, audit management and regulatory compliance.
  • Track record of operating in multi-currency and cross-border finance environments.
  • Hands-on experience with financial systems and ERP platforms (Workday or equivalent).
  • Practical experience with transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance.
  • Background in financial services, professional services, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience supporting international entities or regional finance operations across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information

  • In the Naval Installation discipline, perform /review Naval Architecture Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation

Subcontractors, Project Management Team, Vendors, and Customers

Supervises: Engineers

  • Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards codes and guidelines as applicable for onshore and offshore construction

description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG's software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

title: Especialista de Controladoria
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar na controladoria societária com foco em normas contábeis nacionais e internacionais, assegurando a correta consolidação das demonstrações financeiras, conformidade regulatória e suporte técnico às auditorias externas e internas.

  • Garantir a correta aplicação das normas contábeis (CPC/IFRS) nas demonstrações financeiras consolidadas;
  • Elaborar, revisar e validar balanços patrimoniais, DRE, DFC e notas explicativas;
  • Realizar consolidação contábil de empresas do grupo, incluindo transações intercompany e ajustes de equivalência patrimonial;
  • Apoiar processos de reestruturação societária, fusões, cisões e incorporações;
  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto às auditorias externas e internas, fornecendo suporte e documentação;
  • Realizar análises críticas de contas contábeis, conciliações e validações de saldos;
  • Participar de projetos de melhoria de processos contábeis, automação e compliance;
  • Interagir com áreas como jurídico, fiscal, planejamento e tesouraria para alinhamento de informações societárias;
  • Monitorar atualizações regulatórias e propor ajustes nos processos contábeis conforme necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações

title: Security Operations Center Manager
description:
Gerente de SOC (Security Operations Center Manager)

Modelo híbrido | Local: Escritório no Centro do Rio de Janeiro

Sobre a Empresa

Nosso cliente é um provedor de serviços gerenciados de infraestrutura e cibersegurança, com forte atuação em operações críticas de TI, suportando ambientes corporativos, industriais (OT) e em nuvem. A empresa está em expansão e busca um(a) Gerente de SOC para liderar a evolução de seu Centro de Operações de Segurança.

Desafio da Posição

Você será responsável por liderar, estruturar e evoluir o SOC, garantindo excelência em detecção, análise, resposta e contenção de incidentes de segurança. Fará a gestão de uma operação 24x7, com times multidisciplinares (Blue Team, Threat Hunting, CTI, DFIR) e ambientes complexos (TI + OT + Cloud).

É uma posição estratégica, com alto impacto e interface direta com o CISO e clientes.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a operação do SOC 24x7 e garantir SLAs, KPIs, MTTD/MTTR.
  • Gerenciar equipes de analistas, engenheiros e especialistas (Threat Hunting, CTI, DFIR).
  • Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes críticos.
  • Conduzir investigações avançadas, resposta a incidentes e exercícios de resiliência (tabletop, Purple Team).
  • Evoluir regras de detecção, automações e integrações de SIEM/SOAR/EDR/XDR/NDR.
  • Garantir visibilidade e monitoramento em ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e OT.
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos, métricas e análises baseadas em frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST e ISO 27001.
  • Atuar junto a fornecedores, clientes e áreas internas como NOC, Engenharia e GRC.
  • Apoiar times comerciais em pré-vendas técnicas de cibersegurança.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida liderando SOCs, operações 24x7 e Blue Team.
  • Vivência com SIEM (Elastic, QRadar, Sentinel, Splunk) e SOAR.
  • Forte domínio de EDR/XDR, NDR, IDS/IPS e firewalls.
  • Experiência em Resposta a Incidentes e DFIR.
  • Conhecimento de ambientes Windows, Linux, Active Directory e hardening.
  • Experiência com Cloud Security (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Entendimento de ambientes OT/ICS e Purdue Model.
  • Experiência com scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em Threat Hunting avançado, CTI, detecção comportamental.
  • Atuação em setores regulados (financeiro, energia, saúde, manufatura).
  • Certificações como CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, CEH, GICSP.
  • Certificações cloud (AWS Security, Azure AZ-500, Google PCSE).
  • Conhecimentos em Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, CNAPP.

title: General Manager Operations
description:

We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.

With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.

Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.

About the job:

The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.

Operational Management:

  • Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
  • Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
  • Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.

Financial Management:

  • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
  • Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory); Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
  • Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
  • Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region

title: Analista de Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

QUEM SOMOS:

Em nossa clínica, transformamos vidas através de uma odontologia de excelência. Nossos valores fundamentais de honestidade, comprometimento, dedicação e qualidade guiam cada atendimento e procedimento que realizamos. Somos movidos pela missão de proporcionar saúde bucal de forma ética, humana e responsável, criando experiências únicas para nossos pacientes.


NOSSA VISÃO

Ser uma clínica referência em odontologia de excelência, proporcionando qualidade de vida e saúde bucal através de uma experiência única para nossos clientes. Aqui, cada paciente que chega com traumas e frustrações de experiências anteriores encontra acolhimento, profissionalismo e resultados transformadores.


A OPORTUNIDADE

Buscamos uma Secretária para nossa Central de Relacionamento com o Cliente (CRC) que compartilhe nossa paixão por transformar vidas e seja o primeiro sorriso acolhedor que nossos pacientes encontram ao chegar à clínica.


REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓRIOS:

- Experiência comprovada em clínicas odontológicas ou médicas - Residir OBRIGATORIAMENTE a no máximo 8 km da clínica (exemplo nos bairros: Realengo, Bangu, Campo Grande, Santa Cruz, Sepetiba ou Itaguaí) - Disponibilidade para início imediato


RESPONSABILIDADES:

- Primeiro Contato: Ser a voz e o rosto acolhedor da nossa clínica, recebendo pacientes com empatia e alegria - Gestão de Agenda: Organizar e otimizar os horários dos profissionais, confirmando consultas e evitando faltas - Comunicação Efetiva: Orientar pacientes sobre tratamentos e procedimentos com clareza e segurança - Organização Impecável: Manter prontuários, documentos e sistema atualizados para garantir processos eficientes - Suporte Administrativo: Auxiliar na parte administrativa da clínica, contribuindo para o fluxo de trabalho otimizado


O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS:

- Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita - Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas - Proatividade e resolução eficiente de problemas - Discrição e comprometimento com a confidencialidade - Habilidade com sistemas informatizados e pacote Office - Sorriso genuíno e capacidade de acolher pacientes mesmo em momentos de ansiedade


POR QUE SE JUNTAR A NÓS?

- Propósito Transformador: Fazer parte de histórias reais de transformação na vida das pessoas - Ambiente Inspirador: Trabalhar com uma equipe apaixonada e comprometida com a excelência - Desenvolvimento Profissional: Oportunidade de crescer com uma clínica em expansão - Cultura de Acolhimento: Ambiente que valoriza o bem-estar da equipe e dos pacientes


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

- Regime de Contratação: CLT - Local de Trabalho: CAMPO GRANDE.RJ - Horário: Segunda a sexta, horário comercial (disponibilidade para alguns sábados)

. Remuneração: R$ 2.000,00 + comissão e benefícios


COMO SE CANDIDATAR

Envie seu currículo para com o assunto "Secretária CRC - SORRISOS", destacando seu bairro de residência logo no início do e-mail.


IMPORTANTE: Currículos sem a informação do bairro de residência ou de candidatas residentes fora das áreas mencionadas não serão avaliados.


Se você acredita no poder de um sorriso para transformar vidas e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que trabalha com propósito, queremos conhecer você!

Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
